channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Brasil tenta emplacar fim da escala 6x1 desde os anos 1980
item.description: The Lula government has sent a bill to Congress to reduce the workweek from 44 to 40 hours, establishing a 5x2 schedule without salary cuts. This proposal, distinct from Erika Hilton’s 36-hour plan, seeks a compromise and revives a debate dating back to the 1980s, when a 40-hour week was approved in a constituent assembly committee. The push originated in the early 1980s labor movement, led by groups like the ABC Paulista metalworkers, opposing the 48-hour week entrenched by the 1943 CLT.

item.title: CVM não pode ser moeda de troca em negociação política
item.description: The CVM, which oversees Brazil's R$ 18 trillion capital market, has been without a president for nine months and operates with a reduced board, leading to fewer penalties for irregularities. President Lula's appointment of lawyer Otto Lobo to lead the agency, made early this year, is seen as a political gesture to ease tensions with the Senate, though his confirmation hearing has not yet taken place. Lobo has a record of controversial decisions, including a vote in favor of Banco Master in the Ambipar case, contrary to technical opinions.

item.title: Flávio convida jovens de 16 anos a tirar título de eleitor
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) invited 16-year-olds to obtain their voter registration, stressing the importance of youth participation in the 2026 elections. He criticized the Lula government, accusing it of failing to keep promises and 'stealing the future' of young people, and emphasized the need for change in education, employment, and security.

item.title: Caiado diverge de pré-candidatos de direita e diz apoiar 100% projeto sobre misoginia
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado of the PSD declared full support for the bill criminalizing misogyny, approved by the Federal Senate in April 2026 and currently under debate in the Chamber of Deputies. This stance puts him at odds with other right-wing pre-candidates, who typically oppose such measures. Caiado aims to position himself as a moderate and progressive figure on human rights issues.

item.title: Milei é mal avaliado por 59,7% dos argentinos, diz pesquisa
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei has a 59.7% disapproval rating and 36.2% approval, ranking 14th among 18 Latin American presidents in a CB Global Data survey. Brazil's Lula ranks 7th with 48.4% positive and 49.1% negative evaluations. El Salvador's Nayib Bukele tops the list with 70.1% approval.

item.title: Chefe da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro critica proposta de Dino para o STF, e Gleisi elogia
item.description: The head of Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign criticized Flávio Dino's proposal for a judicial reform at the STF, calling it inadequate. In contrast, PT president Gleisi Hoffmann praised Dino's initiative, emphasizing its importance for strengthening institutional integrity.

item.title: O que prevê acordo entre Brasil e Alemanha sobre minerais críticos e terras raras
item.description: Brazil and Germany signed a joint declaration of intent to expand cooperation on critical minerals and rare earths, focusing on research, development, and innovation across the supply chain. The agreement aims to add value to Brazil’s exports by attracting processing and industrial activities domestically, avoiding reliance on raw material exports alone. Lula emphasized Brazil’s goal to be a strategic actor in the global energy transition, not merely a commodity exporter.

item.title: Oposição articula impeachment de Gilmar Mendes após ministro pedir para STF investigar Romeu Zema
item.description: Opposition lawmakers in the Chamber of Deputies announced an impeachment petition against Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes after he requested that former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema be included in the fake news investigation. Led by Deputy Gilberto Silva (PL-PA), the opposition argues the move sets a dangerous precedent by treating institutional criticism as a prosecutable offense, threatening free speech. Zema’s satirical video, depicting puppet versions of Justices Toffoli and Mendes, is framed as legitimate critique of Mendes’ prior ruling annulling data seizures in Toffoli’s company, which received investments from a fund linked to banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: “Não toleram mais qualquer tipo de piada”, diz Zema sobre STF
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential pre-candidate from the Novo party, accused the STF of persecution after a fake news investigation was opened against him over a satirical video titled 'Os Intocáveis', which uses puppets to criticize the STF's ties to Banco Master. He called the investigation a 'free pass' for ministers to act without accountability and argued that by prosecuting satire, they prove they are the untouchables they claim to criticize. Zema defended free speech, quoting George Orwell, and lamented that Brazil is 'declining' by failing to protect the right to criticize those in power.

item.title: Deputados do PDT acionam STF para anular eleição de Douglas Ruas como presidente da Alerj
item.description: State deputies from the PDT filed an action with the STF to annul the election of Douglas Ruas (PL) as president of the Alerj, arguing that the vote was open rather than secret and that the presidency of the Assembly should not be decided until the STF rules on how the interim governor of Rio de Janeiro will be chosen, given the current institutional vacuum. They demand a new secret-ballot vote to prevent interference and ensure legitimacy.

item.title: Governo alemão usa ‘Show das Poderosas’, da Anitta, em post sobre ida de Lula ao País
item.description: Germany's Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development used Anitta's hit 'Show das Poderosas' as the soundtrack for an Instagram post celebrating 60 years of Brazil-Germany cooperation and Lula's visit. The post highlights agreements on climate, sustainable mobility, and Amazon preservation, reinforcing a shared commitment to multilateralism amid global tensions. The unconventional music choice surprised social media users, sparking memes and Brazilian users tagging Anitta in the comments.

item.title: PDT recorre ao STF contra eleição na Alerj
item.description: The PDT filed an ADPF with the Brazilian Supreme Court to nullify the election that made Douglas Ruas (PL) president of the Alerj, claiming procedural irregularities and requesting a new vote with secret ballot.

item.title: Aliados de Ramagem comemoram expulsão de delegado da PF pelos EUA
item.description: Allies of Alexandre Ramagem celebrate the expulsion of Federal Police delegate Marcelo Ivo by the United States, after he was accused of attempting to manipulate the U.S. immigration system during Ramagem’s arrest in April 2026. Eduardo Bolsonaro and Paulo Figueiredo claim the move was a response to alleged political persecution, while critics like Marcel Van Hattem and Ludmila Lins Grilo call it a national embarrassment. Ramagem was released on April 15 after being detained by ICE.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que São Paulo terá versão da “Times Square”
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas announced plans to install LED panels on buildings in the city center, at the corner of Ipiranga and São João avenues, to create a local version of Times Square. The project, still in planning, includes mapped projection on the Independência 2 Building and aims to revitalize downtown with increased foot traffic, commerce, and tourism, balancing historical respect with urban modernization.

item.title: “Aqueles que se julgam intocáveis não toleram piada”, diz Zema
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) claimed he is being targeted by the Supreme Federal Court (STF) after Minister Gilmar Mendes requested that his name be added to the fake news inquiry via a crime report sent to Minister Alexandre de Moraes. In a video posted on X, Zema stated that 'those who consider themselves untouchable do not tolerate jokes,' implying the investigation is retaliation for criticism or satire directed at authorities.

item.title: Lula é o 7º presidente latino mais bem avaliado, diz pesquisa
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) ranks 7th among Latin American leaders in positive approval, with 48.4% favorable ratings, according to a CB Global Data poll from April 2026. He receives 49.1% negative and 2.5% undecided responses. The ranking is topped by El Salvador’s President Nayib Bukele at 70.1% approval.

item.title: PDT aciona STF para anular eleição que escolheu Douglas Ruas como presidente da Alerj
item.description: The PDT filed a lawsuit at the Supreme Federal Court (STF) seeking to annul the election that chose Douglas Ruas (PL) as president of the Alerj, arguing that open voting violated constitutional principles such as parliamentary mandate freedom, legislative autonomy, and administrative morality. The party also requests a new election with secret ballot and the declaration of unconstitutionality of open nominal voting in the Rio State Legislative Assembly.

item.title: O Código de Ética do STF não foi longe; a reforma do Judiciário de Flávio Dino irá?
item.description: Supreme Court Justice and former Justice Minister Flávio Dino has proposed 15 reforms to the Brazilian Judiciary, including harsher penalties for corrupt judges, ending the well-paid compulsory retirement for corrupt magistrates, and real limits on 'penduricalhos'. Despite being an ally of Lula, Dino has distinguished himself through effective action against parliamentary amendments and judicial excesses, granting him credibility to lead the reform. The initiative comes amid growing revelations of corruption within the Supreme Court, such as ministers' ties to Banco Master, and aims to preempt external intervention through internal self-limitation.

item.title: Zema volta a comparar ações de ministros do STF a casos de 'abuso infantil' na Igreja
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, again compared the actions of Supreme Federal Court (STF) ministers to cases of child abuse in the Church, sparking controversy. The comparison was made during an event on Monday, the 20th, reigniting debate over judicial independence and the limits of public criticism toward authorities.

item.title: PDT pede ao STF que anule eleição da Assembleia do Rio pela segunda vez
item.description: The PDT has filed a second request with the STF to annul the election for the presidency of the Rio de Janeiro Legislative Assembly (Alerj), arguing that open voting exposes deputies to pressure and retaliation, undermining free choice. The party demands a new election with secret ballot, following the election of Douglas Ruas (PL) with 44 votes, which positions him as first in line to succeed the state governorship amid a vacancy in the governor and lieutenant governor offices. The opposition boycotted the vote to avoid endorsing the result, while Ruas seeks to leverage the presidency to advance his gubernatorial campaign.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia vota para condenar Eduardo Bolsonaro por post contra Tabata
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cármen Lúcia voted to condemn Eduardo Bolsonaro for defamation against federal deputy Tabata Amaral, following rapporteur Alexandre de Moraes. The vote is now 2-0 in favor of conviction, with a proposed sentence of one year in open regime detention and a fine of 39 day-fines (equivalent to R$126,438). The final decision depends on the votes of Cristiano Zanin and Flávio Dino, with conclusion expected on April 28.

item.title: Lula e Merz defendem “solução negociada” para conflitos na Ucrânia e no Irã
item.description: Lula and Merz advocated for a negotiated solution to the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran during the Hannover Messe on April 20, 2026. The joint declaration reinforces the Brazil-Germany strategic partnership, emphasizing diplomacy, multilateralism, climate cooperation, circular economy, and global security, while rejecting the use of force and upholding the UN Charter.

item.title: “PF quis dar uma de malandra”, diz Eduardo sobre caso Ramagem
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro celebrated the expulsion of a Brazilian official by the United States, claiming that Federal Police delegate Marcelo Ivo de Carvalho manipulated the immigration system to avoid extraditions and prolong political witch hunts. He accused the PF of acting deceitfully ('dar uma de malandra') against Bolsonaro allies.

item.title: EUA pedem que delegado brasileiro ligado à prisão de Ramagem deixe o país
item.description: The United States has requested that Brazilian delegate Marcelo Ivo leave the country after accusing him of attempting to manipulate the U.S. immigration system to circumvent the formal extradition request for former deputy Alexandre Ramagem. The agent is alleged to have used immigration channels to extend a purported political persecution against Ramagem, who was detained in Orlando in April following his Supreme Court conviction to 16 years in prison for involvement in the January 8 coup plot. The U.S. government states that no foreigner may abuse the U.S. immigration system to evade legal extradition processes.

item.title: EUA mandam delegado da PF que atuou na prisão de Ramagem deixar o país
item.description: The United States has ordered a Brazilian official involved in the arrest of Alexandre Ramagem to leave the country, accusing him of attempting to manipulate U.S. immigration to bypass extradition requests and conduct political persecutions. The official identified is Marcelo Ivo de Carvalho, who allegedly worked with ICE on Ramagem’s April 2026 arrest over immigration matters. Ramagem, who fled Brazil before being sentenced for a coup attempt, claims he entered the U.S. legally and was granted asylum, sparking reactions in the campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Com futuro incerto na política, Castro monta escritório de advocacia
item.description: Former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) reinstated his OAB license after being barred from practicing law during his term and has opened his own law firm, specializing in civil and business law. Despite being invited to join other firms as a partner, he chose to go solo. He remains intent on running for Senate in 2026, though his eligibility hinges on the TSE ruling regarding abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections, awaiting the official decision for potential appeal.

item.title: Moro sai em defesa de Zema após pedido de Gilmar no inquérito das fake news
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-RJ) criticized Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes for requesting that former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) be included in the fake news investigation, arguing the Court has abandoned its role as guardian of freedom and become its opposite. Moro defended Zema, suggesting Mendes’ request is politically motivated and threatens free speech.

item.title: Dino propõe revisão de competências do STF e tribunais superiores e mais rigor para corrupção de juízes
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino proposes a New Judiciary Reform with 15 axes, including reviewing the STF and superior courts’ competencies, altering electoral process proceedings, and tightening criminal law to punish corruption involving judges, prosecutors, and lawyers. STF President Edson Fachin praised the proposal as timely and well-structured, while Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) agrees reform is needed but criticizes the omission of issues like prolonged monocratic decisions and relatives of ministers participating in cases they could judge.

item.title: EUA expulsam delegado da PF por ‘contornar pedidos de extradição’ após episódio da prisão de Ramagem
item.description: The United States has ordered the departure of Federal Police delegate Marcelo Ivo for attempting to manipulate the immigration system, circumvent formal extradition requests, and extend political persecution onto U.S. territory, following the release of Alexandre Ramagem, a former federal deputy convicted by the STF of coup d'état who fled to the U.S. The PF stated it has not been formally notified of the decision.

item.title: Marinho defende reforma do Judiciário liderada pelo Legislativo
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) argues that judicial reform should be led by the Legislative Power, questioning the timing of the PT's proposal and a concurrent article by STF Minister Flávio Dino as potentially coordinated. He stresses the need for reform to ensure impartiality in the highest courts but warns that key issues — such as prolonged monocratic decisions, relatives of justices involved in cases, and the STF functioning as an investigative body — are being overlooked. Without addressing these, he warns reform risks becoming a superficial adjustment rather than meaningful change.

item.title: Alvo de Gilmar, Zema diz que STF não dá o “devido direito de defesa”
item.description: Romeu Zema, a pre-candidate for president from the Novo party, criticized the STF for allegedly denying due process after receiving a criminal complaint from Gilmar Mendes over satirical videos. He stated he was not notified and views this as a pattern by some justices. The case relates to the ongoing fake news inquiry, under seal since 2019, and the 'Os Intocáveis' series mocking justices like Mendes and Toffoli.

item.title: Cármen vota para condenar Eduardo Bolsonaro por difamação contra Tabata
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cármen Lúcia voted to convict Eduardo Bolsonaro for defamation against Deputy Tabata Amaral, following rapporteur Alexandre de Moraes. The accusation involves spreading false claims about a bill proposed by Amaral for free distribution of sanitary pads. The trial is ongoing in the First Chamber of the STF, with two votes so far in favor of conviction.

item.title: STF tem dois votos para condenar Eduardo por difamação contra Tabata Amaral
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Court has two votes to convict former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro for defamation against federal deputy Tabata Amaral, with Justices Alexandre de Moraes and Cármen Lúcia supporting a sentence of one year in open regime detention and a fine equivalent to 39 day-fines. The case stems from false statements made by Bolsonaro against Amaral during the 2022 election campaign.

item.title: Cármen segue Moraes e vota para condenar Eduardo Bolsonaro por difamação
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cármen Lúcia voted to convict Eduardo Bolsonaro for defamation against Deputy Tabata Amaral, following rapporteur Alexandre de Moraes. The ruling confirms that the former deputy committed defamation by making offensive statements against the lawmaker.

item.title: Com Zema na mira, relembre outros políticos que foram alvos do inquérito das fake news
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes requested the inclusion of former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) in the fake news inquiry after an animation he published simulated an illicit conversation between Ministers Alexandre de Moraes and Dias Toffoli regarding the Banco Master investigation. The request reignites criticism over the inquiry’s indefinite duration, particularly from Bolsonaro allies citing a February 2024 OAB letter calling for the closure of prolonged investigations. Opened in 2019 and extended to 2027 by the STF, the inquiry has led to arrests, asset freezes, and spawned other investigations, including the Digital Militias probe.

item.title: Zema volta a comparar ações de ministros do STF a casos de ‘abuso infantil’ na igreja
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo), a pre-candidate for president, compared the actions of STF ministers to cases of child abuse in the Catholic Church, citing alleged ties between Corte members and banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, which was liquidated by the BC. He criticized a request by Minister Gilmar Mendes to include him in a fake news inquiry after sharing a critical video about the Court. Zema said such conduct provokes 'disgust' and that he is not radical, merely indignant about alleged conflicts of interest involving the STF.

item.title: Lula e Merz defendem diplomacia e rejeitam uso da força em conflitos globais
item.description: President Lula and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz issued a joint statement rejecting the use of force against the political and territorial independence of any state, expressing concern over the wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, and advocating diplomacy as the path to resolve global conflicts.

item.title: O custo do desmonte da Petrobras em tempos de guerra
item.description: The article criticizes the dismantling of Petrobras, particularly the 2021 sale of BR Distribuidora, which broke the state-owned company’s integrated 'from well to pump' model and reduced its ability to control domestic fuel prices. Amid Middle East war and global energy market volatility, Brazil’s near 30% reliance on imported gasoline, cooking gas, jet kerosene, and especially diesel leaves it vulnerable to external shocks. The authors argue that restoring Petrobras’ vertical integration is essential for energy sovereignty and shielding consumers from abusive price hikes by private distributors.

item.title: Lula “dirige” caminhão em vídeo sobre biocombustíveis na Alemanha
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva posted a social media video during his visit to the Hannover industrial fair in Germany, where he staged driving a truck to promote Brazilian biodiesel. He stated that tests showed ethanol does not compromise engine autonomy and urged the world to use biodiesel and ethanol for genuine decarbonization. Lula also showcased Brazilian-made vehicles and said his European trip yielded 10 agreements and at least 9 announcements on AI, climate, defense, and energy.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia acompanha Moraes e vota para condenar Eduardo Bolsonaro por difamação contra Tabata
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia followed rapporteur Alexandre de Moraes in voting to convict Eduardo Bolsonaro for defamation against Deputy Tabata Amaral, over false claims about a sanitary pads bill. Moraes sentenced Bolsonaro to one year in open regime detention and 39 day-fines, totaling approximately R$126,400. The First Chamber of the STF now stands at 2-0 for conviction, awaiting votes from Cristiano Zanin and Flávio Dino.

item.title: Zema: Levarei minha candidatura até o fim; oposição estará junta no segundo turno
item.description: Former governor Romeu Zema (Novo) reaffirmed he will pursue his presidential pre-candidacy to the end and believes the right will unite in a potential runoff against Lula. He argued that a proliferation of right-wing candidates complicates the landscape for the left.

item.title: PT prega Código de Ética para STF e revisão de privilégios na Corte após desgaste na imagem de Lula
item.description: Following the Banco Master scandal that undermined STF credibility and affected Lula’s popularity, the PT is advocating for a Judicial Code of Ethics and the review of judicial privileges as part of its platform for the 8th Party Congress. The proposal aims to balance powers, combat impositive amendments, and strengthen public oversight of the Judiciary while preserving its independence and ensuring institutional accountability. Coordinated by José Dirceu, the initiative signals a strategic shift by the government in response to institutional damage caused by the politicization of justice.

item.title: Lula nega turbulência na pré-campanha e diz estar tranquilo
item.description: Lula denied turbulence in his re-election pre-campaign, stating he remains calm and views elections as a normal democratic process. He emphasized his extensive electoral experience and downplayed Flávio Bolsonaro's lead in the Datafolha poll, citing the margin of error and the early stage of the race. Lula also advocated for UN Security Council reform, opposed military intervention in Cuba, and supported South Africa's inclusion in the G20.

item.title: Vasco bate o São Paulo de virada em São Januário
item.description: Vasco defeated São Paulo 2-1 at São Januário, with goals from Puma Rodríguez (penalty) and Andrés Gomez, after Luciano opened the scoring for São Paulo. The comeback lifted Vasco to 16 points and 10th place in the 2026 Brasileirão, while São Paulo remains on 20 points in fourth.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia acompanha Moraes e condena Eduardo Bolsonaro por crime contra Tabata Amaral
item.description: Justice Alexandre de Moraes, the rapporteur, voted to convict Eduardo Bolsonaro for defamation against Deputy Tabata Amaral, imposing a one-year detention sentence in an open regime. Justice Cármen Lúcia followed Moraes’ vote without reservations, bringing the tally to two votes in favor of conviction. A majority in the Supreme Court requires four additional justices to align with Moraes; the virtual deliberation remains open until April 28.

item.title: Flávio visita o pai e viaja para evento do agronegócio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) visited former President Jair Bolsonaro under house arrest in Brasília on Monday (20/4). He is expected to remain in the capital during the Tiradentes holiday (21/4) and travel on Wednesday (22/4) to Sinop (MT) to attend the Norte Show, an agribusiness fair.

item.title: Zema vai responder a Gilmar em discurso no dia de Tiradentes
item.description: Romeu Zema will use his speech at the Tiradentes medal ceremony in Ouro Preto to respond to Gilmar Mendes, who urged Alexandre de Moraes to investigate Zema in the fake news inquiry over satirical videos posted on his social media last month.

item.title: Lula propõe a Merz convidar Trump para assistir final da Copa
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva proposed to German Chancellor Friedrich Merz that they invite former U.S. President Donald Trump to attend a potential 2026 World Cup final between Brazil and Germany, referencing Brazil’s 7–1 loss in 2014. Lula said if the two teams reach the final, he and Merz will be in the stadium. The remark was made during the 42nd Brazil-Germany Economic Meeting in Hanover, Germany.

item.title: Lula chama bloqueio a Cuba de “ideológico” e “vergonha mundial”
item.description: President Lula denounced the U.S. embargo on Cuba as 'ideological' and a 'global shame', rejected any military intervention on the island, and advocated for diplomatic solutions to international conflicts, including Ukraine, the Middle East, and G20 inclusion, alongside German Chancellor Friedrich Merz.

item.title: Lula assina 15 atos durante viagem à Alemanha. Saiba quais
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed 15 acts during his visit to Germany, covering cooperation in defense, critical minerals, environment, and small and medium-sized enterprises. The agreements include declarations of intent for joint defense equipment procurement, combating environmental crimes, and strengthening strategic dialogue on climate and economic cooperation.
